info.title: World Bank (Independent Publisher)
info.description: Power Platform custom connector for accessing World Bank Indicators, Country Metadata, and Reference Data.

get.description: Retrieve a time series of an economic indicator for a country, region, or income group. Supports 'all' for all countries.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: The ISO 3-letter country code (e.g., USA, FRA, JPN).

parameters.name: indicatorCode
parameters.description: World Bank indicator code (e.g., SP.POP.TOTL, NY.GDP.MKTP.CD).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format of the response. Use 'json' for JSON, or 'xml' for XML.

parameters.name: mrv
parameters.description: The number of most recent values to retrieve. Overrides the date range if specified.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of results to retrieve, for paginated responses.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Filter by a specific year (e.g., '2020') or range (e.g., '2010:2020').
